correctness.rationale: Unrestricted proof: after two distinct positive queries, common centers have distance >=3 empty, distance 2 four elements, or distance 1 two blocks A and B. Exact query-trace classification on A union B forces Ldim <=3, and <=2 for min(k,n-k)=3, n<=9, or (10,5). Two positive steps give global upper 5 or 4. The two explicitly encoded complete trees for J(6,3) and J(10,4) have 16 and 32 distinct leaf witnesses; the independently run checker validates all path answers, and induced embeddings propagate lower bounds across every asserted parameter.

value.rationale: A complete exact online dimension classification for natural distance-regular Johnson graphs at every interior rank, a sharp uniform inherited bound for induced subgraphs, and the first rank-sensitive adaptive/static gap at J(10,4). The result uses a structural positive-trace lemma and natural graph-family embeddings rather than arbitrary finite parameter selection.
